lines.english: He's wearing a colourful hat on his head.

lines.serbian: To je poklon od njegove ćerke.
lines.croatian: To je poklon od njegove kćeri.
lines.english: It's a gift from his daughter.
The hat flies far away, across the street.

lines.serbian: Jovan traži kapu, ali ne vidi ništa.
lines.croatian: Jovan traži kapu, ali ne vidi ništa.
lines.english: Jovan looks for the hat, but he can't see anything.

lines.serbian: Ide u kafić i pije čaj.
lines.croatian: Ide u kafić i pije čaj.
lines.english: He goes to a café and drinks tea.

lines.serbian: Stefan otvara torbu i vadi šarenu kapu.
lines.croatian: Stefan otvara torbu i vadi šarenu kapu.
lines.english: Stefan opens his bag and takes out a colourful hat.

lines.serbian: – Na klupi u parku. Malo je prljava.
lines.croatian: – Na klupi u parku. Malo je prljava.
lines.english: "On a bench in the park. It's a little dirty."

lines.serbian: – Nema na čemu. Ali ti plaćaš čaj.
lines.croatian: – Nema na čemu. Ali ti plaćaš čaj.
lines.english: "You're welcome. But you're paying for the tea."
There's a discount at the café today.

lines.serbian: Jovan plaća gotovinom i smeje se.
lines.croatian: Jovan plaća gotovinom i smije se.
lines.english: Jovan pays in cash and laughs.
